defects_found_by_running_it.what: Every dialogue was skipped on the first attempt with 'Failed to decode the last byte tokens'.
defects_found_by_running_it.cause: tools/tokenize_text.py defaults --text_tokenizer_repo to kyutai/moshiko-pytorch-bf16, an English tokenizer. Every Japanese character falls to byte fallback and encode_as_pieces_wo_byte_fallback cannot reassemble it.
defects_found_by_running_it.note: This is not a data defect. The condition-2 ledger distinguishes it, because a skip caused by the wrong tokenizer says nothing about the dialogue.

defects_found_by_running_it.what: tokenize_audio failed to start with 'Symbol not found: _aoti_torch_abi_version'.
defects_found_by_running_it.cause: torch and torchaudio resolved to a mismatched pair in the ephemeral environment; uv.lock is gitignored so this differs per run.

parquet.min_length_flag: omitted, so nothing is dropped by length at training time

training_shape.why_computed_offline: finetune.py prints these only after loading an 8.4B model onto two GPUs. Computing them costs nothing and lets --save_steps be pinned correctly at launch; the startup log then verifies rather than discovers.
training_shape.why_the_count_is_not_just_the_epochs: finetune.py saves in-loop on save_steps and again unconditionally after the loop, with no rotation. At 72 rows S is 9 and the post-loop save reuses step_45, giving five. At 80 rows S would be 10, total 50, and the post-loop save would add a sixth directory - 100 GB of disk nobody planned for.

launch_assertions.action_if_different: kill immediately; the dataset is not the one this was computed from
